theme_settings.design_philosophy: Utilitarian, high-contrast command center layout. Emphasizes legibility, strict hierarchy, and raw data exposure over decorative elements. Uses dark zinc base with stark white text and bright warning yellow for focal points.

structural_rules.sidebar: fixed left-0 top-0 h-full w-64 border-r border-zinc-800 bg-zinc-950 flex flex-col z-40

buttons.primary: bg-yellow-400 text-zinc-950 hover:bg-yellow-500 font-bold rounded-sm px-4 py-2 transition-colors inline-flex items-center justify-center
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-zinc-300 hover:bg-zinc-800 border border-zinc-700 hover:border-zinc-600 rounded-sm px-4 py-2 transition-colors inline-flex items-center justify-center
buttons.danger: bg-red-500/10 text-red-500 hover:bg-red-500/20 border border-red-500/20 rounded-sm px-4 py-2 transition-colors

inputs.default: bg-zinc-950 border border-zinc-800 rounded-sm text-zinc-100 px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-yellow-400 focus:border-yellow-400 placeholder:text-zinc-600 transition-all

tables.header: bg-zinc-900 border-b border-zinc-800 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider text-zinc-400 text-left

badges.status_active: bg-green-500/10 text-green-400 border border-green-500/20 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-sm text-xs font-medium uppercase
badges.status_inactive: bg-red-500/10 text-red-400 border border-red-500/20 px-2 py-0.5 rounded-sm text-xs font-medium uppercase
badges.serial_number: font-mono text-xs text-zinc-400 bg-zinc-950 px-1.5 py-0.5 rounded-sm border border-zinc-800

hierarchy_groups: OFFICERS (PO III, PO II, PO I, Kadet)
employee_list.group_header_style: bg-zinc-50 text-zinc-950 font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.15em] py-2 px-4 rounded-sm mb-2 mt-8 flex items-center shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,255,255,0.1)]

officer_profile.permissions: If user role is 'employee', heavily enforce disabled UI. Inputs and checkboxes must visually reflect read-only state (opacity-50, cursor-not-allowed). If 'founder', full interactive access.
officer_profile.merit_bars: 6 text fields (Paski Zasługi) styled aggressively in a grid to look like military ribbon slots.
officer_profile.trainings: Checkboxes for: OPP, KPP, Strzelanie, Taktyka, Prawo, Pierwsza Pomoc. Grouped in a tactical 2-column or 3-column bento layout.
officer_profile.assigned_equipment_list: Display item Name + S/N prominently. S/N should use the `serial_number` mono badge style.

equipment_inventory.layout: Data-heavy table prioritizing S/N, Name, Category, Status, and Assignee.
equipment_inventory.delete_action: Requires a visual confirmation (dialog) highlighting 'Usuwanie kaskadowe' (cascading delete) warning in red.

registration.requirements: Form must include Badge Number (numeric/text input) and Position (select dropdown). Must feel like a secured terminal entry.

visual_enhancers.borders: Utilize 1px solid strokes (border-zinc-800) heavily to define regions. Avoid soft drop shadows. Use 'Inner Glow' highlights sparingly.
visual_enhancers.hover_states: Interactive elements must lighten on hover. Yellow buttons get brighter. Zinc buttons get lighter zinc backgrounds.
visual_enhancers.icons: Use 'lucide-react'. Icons should be crisp, sized w-4 h-4 or w-5 h-5, and stroke-width 2.

doc_logo.description: Department of Corrections Shield Logo. Use in sidebar header.

tactical_bg.description: Tactical grid background. Use for login page or empty states with max 10% opacity overlay.

tactical_gear_placeholder.description: Tactical gear photo. Use as a banner in the Equipment page header if visual interest is needed.

accessibility_and_testing.data_testid: ALL interactive elements MUST include `data-testid` attributes (e.g., `data-testid="login-submit-button"`, `data-testid="nav-equipment"`).
accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure pure white or bright yellow on dark zinc backgrounds for AAA contrast.
accessibility_and_testing.animations: Minimalist micro-interactions only. Avoid bouncy or slow transitions. Use quick, sharp transitions (duration-150 ease-out) fitting a military UI.
